decisions.rationale: Only direction that differentiates from n8n/Make/Zapier
Serves both non-technical and technical users; node-level progressive avoids upfront decision anxiety

decisions.decision: nodeOutputs = single source of truth, variables = derived view
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review found dual storage creates divergence bugs

decisions.decision: Condition V1/V2 dual executor strategy (not auto-migration)
decisions.rationale: v1 expression cannot be deterministically migrated to v2 format

decisions.decision: AI-generated workflows must never contain code nodes (server-side enforcement)
decisions.rationale: RCE risk: AI gen + code executor = arbitrary JS execution on server

decisions.decision: Webhook route exempt from API_AUTH_KEY, mandatory webhook secret
decisions.rationale: External services cannot send x-api-key header; webhook path alone is not sufficient security

decisions.decision: Per-execution EventEmitter instead of global singleton
decisions.rationale: Autoplan eng review found listener leak under concurrent load
Per-node-type independent editors enable parallel development and easy iteration

decisions.decision: Condition: single rule (field+operator+value) with optional dynamic field dropdown
decisions.rationale: Covers 80% use cases; AND/OR can be added later without architecture change

decisions.decision: HTTP headers stored as KV array (not JSON string)
decisions.rationale: Visual editor needs structured data; JSON string was user-unfriendly

next_action: Start Phase 1 backend: (1) Redesign nodeOutputs/variables in engine.ts as single source + derived view, (2) Add integration test framework, (3) Implement Condition V2 executor with dual-format support.
